faqPage.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqPage.subtitle: Answers to the most common questions

items.q: Are there fees the traveler pays to apply for jobs?
items.a: We are fully transparent. Administrative fees are set according to Egyptian law and signed agreements, and no amounts are collected except within approved official procedures.

items.q: How do I know the status of my application after registering?
items.a: Once your CV matches an open job request, the recruitment team will contact you by phone or WhatsApp to schedule an interview.

items.q: Does the company only complete travel procedures without recruitment?
items.a: Yes. We provide visa clearance and consular attestation even if the contract was signed directly between you and the employer.

items.q: How long does it take to provide talent?
items.a: We submit a shortlist of candidates within 3 to 7 working days. Travel time then depends on the occupation and consular regulations.

items.q: Do you guarantee the selected talent?
items.a: Yes. We guarantee the worker’s competence and conduct throughout the 90-day probation period, and we compensate if they are not a fit.

items.q: How do you verify the skills of technical workers?
items.a: We have equipped specialized testing centers, and we also let the employer interview by video conference or visit our Cairo office.

items.q: What documents are required to apply?
items.a: Applications require a CV, a copy of the academic qualification, a copy of the passport, and experience certificates if available.

items.q: Can I cancel my application after registering?
items.a: Yes. You can cancel your request at any time before official procedures begin by contacting the recruitment team.

items.q: Which countries are available for recruitment?
items.a: We currently focus on the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and the Gulf countries.

privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.intro: Al-Gamaa for the Deployment of Egyptian Labor Abroad is committed to protecting your privacy. This policy explains how we collect, use, and share your information when you use our website.

sections.title: Information we collect
items: Personal information you provide voluntarily, such as name, phone number, email, address, and educational qualifications.
Files you upload through the site, such as a CV or other employment documents.
Device and browser information, such as browser type, operating system, and IP address, to improve your experience.

sections.title: How we use information
items: Assessing job applications and managing the nomination process for available roles.
Contacting you about job opportunities, inquiries, or service updates.
Improving site performance and developing our services to match user needs.
Complying with applicable legal and regulatory obligations.

sections.title: Data sharing
items: We do not sell or rent your personal data to any third party.
We may share information with employers or competent government authorities only when necessary to complete the recruitment process.
We use trusted service providers to host the site and manage data, and they are bound by confidentiality and privacy agreements.

sections.title: Data security
items: We use encryption and secure connections (HTTPS) to protect data in transit.
We apply technical and organizational measures to limit unauthorized access to your data.
Despite our efforts, no internet transmission can be guaranteed as completely secure; please keep your account details confidential.

sections.title: User rights
items: The right to access your personal data and request a copy of it.
The right to correct any inaccurate or incomplete information.
The right to request deletion of your data, subject to legal retention obligations.
The right to object to some processing methods or withdraw your consent at any time.

sections.title: Contact us
items: If you have any question or request about this privacy policy, you can contact us via:
Email: info@algamaa.com.eg
Address: 26 El-Sadat, Al-Nozha, Nasr City, Cairo, Egypt

aboutPage.title: The strongest bridge and the leading destination for international recruitment

intro.p1: We are Al-Gamaa Company for the Placement of Egyptian Manpower Abroad (LLC), operating under Egyptian Ministry of Manpower license No. (726). We are proud to be the trusted strategic partner of leading institutions and business leaders in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
intro.p2: Our company was founded to lead the human resources sector. We specialize in selecting and placing top Egyptian talent, and supporting the Saudi market with professional cadres who contribute effectively to Vision 2030.
intro.p3: At Al-Gamaa we do not stop at recruitment — we build lasting partnerships founded on competence, integrity, and absolute professionalism.

section1.title: International recruitment and workforce placement
items: We act as a strategic partner managing the full recruitment cycle professionally
Elite sourcing: precise selection based on merit and labor-market requirements
Smart interviews: equipped halls or remote video-conference interviews
End-to-end logistics: from contracting and medicals through travel arrangements
Musaned services: domestic-worker procedures with direct electronic integration

section2.title: Consular services and work visas
items: Deep expertise that turns complex procedures into a fast, simple path
Saudi visa handling through consulates in Cairo, Alexandria, and Suez
Electronic authorization on approved visa platforms (Enjaz)
TasHeel biometric bookings and GAMCA medical appointments
Full file review before submission to avoid delays or rejection

section3.title: International documentation and attestation
items: We handle government reviews and secure official recognition for international use
Academic qualifications attested via the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Cultural Attaché
Personal and professional papers: birth, marriage, powers of attorney, and experience certificates
Employment contracts attested to protect all parties legally

section4.title: Musaned platform (domestic services)
items: A safe, organized recruitment experience with a direct Musaned connection
Official attestation through labor-office electronic integration
Visa issuance handled through to the worker’s visa
Approved procedures including fees, medical insurance, and medical exams
Step-by-step Musaned support from receiving your request until departure
